worldcombat.skill.thunderpunch.summary: An electrified fist strikes the first target along the aim direction and settles most of the punch damage first; it then has to hold for a moment, and only if both are still in reach with clear sight does it settle the rest and chain the current from the real target to the nearest foes. Every struck target may be left paralyzed; a target that backs off in time takes only the first punch, with no chain.
worldcombat.skill.thunderpunch.use.0: Open with a quick electrified jab
worldcombat.skill.thunderpunch.use.1: Let the current chain to a second foe beside the target
worldcombat.skill.thunderpunch.use.2: Spread paralysis across several targets quickly
worldcombat.skill.thunderpunch.descripti: The punch along the aim direction deals about %1$s contact and punch damage with a %2$s block fist radius; after the hit it must hold for a %3$s contact window, and only if both are still in reach with clear sight is the remaining third of the damage settled.
The target hit directly by the punch has a %1$s chance to be left paralyzed (half movement speed, a 25%% chance for its actions to fail) for about 40 s.

After a successful discharge, the current jumps from the real target to up to %2$s more foes within %1$s blocks, each taking about %3$s damage with a %4$s paralysis chance; a target without line of sight or one that has left is not chained.
worldcombat.skill.thunderpunch.overcharg: Overcharge: the current jumps farther, can chain to a third target and paralyzes more on the jump, but the punch is lighter, the main paralysis lower and the cooldown longer.
Focused: a heavier punch and more concentrated paralysis, but the current chains a shorter distance.
worldcombat.skill.thunderpunch.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.thunderpunch.growth.0: From level %1$s the punch power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.thunderpunch.growth.1: From level %1$s the punch power rises to %2$s and the jump range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.thunderpunch.preferenc: On: jump range x1.3, +1 extra target, jump paralysis +6%%, but punch power x0.88, main paralysis -4%% and cooldown +4 ticks, for fighting groups. Off (focused): a heavier punch and more concentrated main paralysis, but a shorter chain.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The jab reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: when foes crowd beside the target the user jabs first, lighting several at once; off: order by ordinary melee only.
